content.text:
No, `#0055ff` on white doesn't meet AA for body text. `klar contrast` gives 4.3, and the AA minimum for body text is 4.5.

Use `#0153f8` instead. It scores 4.5, which passes, and it is visually almost identical (ΔE ≈ 1). `klar find` reached it by nudging lightness and chroma slightly. Lightness alone couldn't get there, so it needed `--allow-desaturation`.

If you'd rather keep the brand color exactly, `#0055ff` is fine for large text (3:1) and UI elements, just not body text.

I haven't changed any files. I can update the token if you like.
